entries.ru: Кто-то звонил, но я не взял трубку.
entries.en: Someone called, but I didn't pick up. (a specific person — I just don't know who)

entries.ru: Я что-то купил по дороге домой.
entries.en: I bought something on the way home. (a specific thing — I know what it is)
He lives somewhere on the outskirts. (a specific place — I just don't know exactly where)
She worked at a school at some point. (a specific time in the past)
For some reason he stayed silent all evening. (there is a reason — I don't know it)

entries.ru: Как-то раз я встретил его в метро.
entries.en: Once I ran into him on the metro. (one specific occasion)

entries.ru: Что-то мне подсказывает, что он врёт.
entries.en: Something tells me he's lying. (a specific feeling I can't articulate)
Someone left an umbrella in the hallway. (a specific umbrella, a specific someone — unknown)

entries.ru: Кто-нибудь звонил, пока меня не было?
entries.en: Did anyone call while I was out? (any caller at all — no one specific in mind)
Buy something to go with tea. (anything will do — no specific item in mind)
Let's meet somewhere in the centre. (anywhere in the centre — undecided)
Drop by sometime. (any time in the future — indefinite)
If anything happens, call me. (any possible thing)
Tell me something interesting. (anything interesting — you choose)
Maybe someone knows the answer? (does any one of you know — unknown who)
He'll manage somehow. (by some means — undetermined)

name.en: «кое-» — known to the speaker but not named

entries.en: A certain someone came by, but didn't introduce themselves. (I know who — I'm not saying)
I need to tell you something. (a specific thing — I know what, but not yet)
He went to a few places this summer. (specific places — I know which, but won't list them)
I forgot a few details. (specific details — I know which ones I've forgotten)
We barely made it home. (with difficulty — fixed expression, means 'somehow, with effort')
Someone called. (a specific person) — Did anyone call? (any caller at all)
I bought something. (a specific thing) — Buy something. (anything)

entries.ru: Он где-то живёт. — Давай встретимся где-нибудь.
entries.en: He lives somewhere. (a specific place) — Let's meet somewhere. (anywhere)

entries.ru: Она когда-то работала здесь. — Заходи когда-нибудь.
entries.en: She worked here at some point. (a specific past time) — Drop by sometime. (any future time)

entries.ru: Кое-кто звонил. — Кто-то звонил. — Кто-нибудь звонил?
entries.en: A certain someone called. (I know who) — Someone called. (unknown to me) — Did anyone call? (any caller)
